why_this_comes_first: OpenChia's Episode controller stops when the upper uncertainty bound of the predicted next-unit yield falls to a tolerance.
Neither chian/OpenChia (98d74fb) nor chian/nano-graphrag (546526a) publishes a calibration of that statistic: no coverage,
bias or simulation record exists in either repository, and nano-graphrag's experiments/log and experiments/runs are not committed.
The one passed live acceptance (epistemic_yield_acceptance.md, 2026-10-02) stopped after two units under a bound that was
'not the shipped default' (projected upper bound ~0.749 vs default tolerance 0.01). Before our experiments lean on this rule,
its behaviour on populations with KNOWN richness must be measured. This is a method-level test on synthetic truth; the
implementation-level test (the same inputs through OpenChia's numeric_control_library) follows and requires executing
external code, which the owner performs.

estimators_reimplemented_independently: Wilson interval on the per-unit incidence probability (rarefaction.py _wilson_probability)
Jeffreys-gamma posterior on the singleton rate for the conditional next-unit yield (rarefaction.py _conditional_next_yield)
bias-corrected Chao1 remaining richness: ((n-1)/n) * f1*(f1-1) / (2*(f2+1)) with its delta-method variance (rarefaction.py _remaining_richness)
stop rule: upper bound of predicted next-unit yield <= theta (continuation.py predicted_credit_upper_bound), with theta in {0.01, 0.02, 0.05}
deliberately_not_reimplemented: the relaxed geometric hypervolume normalisation and channel conjunction in credit_assignment.py (one channel is simulated; credit = fraction of distinct identities, so hypervolume reduces to it)
nano-graphrag's larger 'preferential_incidence_estimator_v2' (a different, undocumented estimator; out of scope for a documented-formula test)
what_is_tested.ground_truth: a finite population of K distinct identities; each unit draws a set of identities; detection probabilities are known, so remaining richness after any unit is known exactly

conditions.units_per_draw: Poisson-sized sets, mean 5, from the detection distribution
conditions.heterogeneous_heavy: log-normal detection weights, sigma 2.0 (the web-search regime: a few sources very easy to hit, many nearly unreachable)

measures.coverage: fraction of (replicate, unit) pairs in which the remaining-richness band contains the true remaining count; nominal 0.95
measures.stop_unit: first unit at which upper(next-yield) <= theta
measures.undiscovered_at_stop: true fraction of K not yet seen at the stop unit
measures.premature_stop_rate: fraction of replicates stopping with > 10% of K undiscovered
measures.never_stop_rate: fraction of replicates that do not stop within 50*K/5 units

P1_homogeneous_calibrated.claim: Under equal detection, the band is approximately calibrated and the stop is safe.
P1_homogeneous_calibrated.prediction: coverage >= 0.90 for every K; undiscovered_at_stop median <= 0.02 at theta = 0.01
P1_homogeneous_calibrated.falsified_if: coverage < 0.90 at any K, or median undiscovered at stop > 0.02

P2_heterogeneous_premature.claim: Chao1's known downward bias under unequal detection makes the stop fire early.
P2_heterogeneous_premature.prediction: at sigma = 2.0 and theta = 0.01, premature_stop_rate >= 0.25 and coverage <= 0.80 for K = 1000

P3_tolerance_matters_more_than_K.claim: The tolerance theta, not the population size, governs how much is left undiscovered.
P3_tolerance_matters_more_than_K.prediction: undiscovered_at_stop at theta = 0.05 is at least 2x that at theta = 0.01 in every condition

P4_two_units_cannot_stop_at_default.claim: Reproducing the acceptance record's situation: after two observed units, the default tolerance cannot fire.
P4_two_units_cannot_stop_at_default.prediction: for every condition, upper(next-yield) after 2 units > 0.5, so the default 0.01 never stops at n = 2
P4_two_units_cannot_stop_at_default.falsified_if: any replicate stops at n <= 2 under theta = 0.01

what_a_result_means.P1_holds_P2_holds: the rule is sound where sampling is even and unsafe where it is uneven; for literature search and candidate generation the heterogeneity regime is the realistic one, so the stop must be read as 'nothing EASY remains', not 'nothing remains'
what_a_result_means.P1_fails: the statistic is miscalibrated even in the favourable case; do not build on it without an upstream fix
what_a_result_means.P2_fails: heterogeneity is handled better than Chao1 theory predicts; investigate why before trusting it
what_a_result_means.P4_fails: my reading of the acceptance record is wrong
